summary: Reliance Digital advertises the 256GB iPhone 17 Pro at an effective ₹56,990, down from its ₹1,34,900 launch price. The offer combines an in-store discount, eligible smartphone exchange value and bonus, and qualifying bank cashback; it is not a flat discount for all buyers.

title: Dell's latest 14-inch laptop brings 120Hz screen and long battery life at lower starting price — details here
summary: Dell has launched the 14S DS14270 laptop globally, with prices starting at $649 in the US. It is powered by Intel Wildcat Lake processors. The 14-inch laptop offers up to 16GB RAM, 1TB storage and an optional 120Hz display, while weighing just 1.15kg.

title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge effectively available at ₹30,399 on Amazon with exchange offer: Check deal details
summary: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge is available on Amazon at ₹67,999, down from its listed price of ₹1,09,999. With an exchange value of up to ₹37,600, buyers can get the smartphone at an effective price of ₹30,399.

title: Google, Apple and Mozilla block 8 eMudhra certificates over weak keys: What users need to know
summary: Google, Apple and Mozilla have blocked eight digital certificates issued by the Indian certificate authority eMudhra after researchers found dangerously weak private keys. The flaw could let attackers impersonate websites.&nbsp;

title: Tech giants AI spending to exceed USD 1 trillion in 2027, lift US growth: UBS
summary: Investment by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure is expected to exceed USD 1 trillion in 2027 as demand for computing capacity continues to outstrip supply, supporting US economic growth despite rising financing needs, according to a report by UBS.

title: Samsung One UI 9.0 rolls out to Galaxy S23 in Europe: Is your phone eligible?
summary: Samsung has begun rolling out the stable Android 17-based One UI 9.0 update to the Galaxy S23 series in Europe, starting with beta programme users. The 516.69 MB update brings Quick Panel customisation, a location privacy indicator and new AI features.

title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple to open pre-orders on November 1
summary: Temple is a head-worn device that tracks blood flow and oxygenation inside the brain. Goyal, who stepped down as Eternal CEO in February, had said in August that pre-orders for a limited launch edition would open soon.

title: Blinkit sees no compelling case for expanding private labels, says Dhindsa
summary: Albinder Dhindsa, CEO of Eternal, voiced skepticism regarding the potential for private labels to enhance profit margins. He emphasised that effective brand development mandates considerable investment in both marketing and product development, areas where Blinkit falls short.

title: Glance to be integrated by default on Android TVs in US, India, Japan in partnership with Google
summary: Under the collaboration, Glance will transform idle TV screens into interactive shoppable storefronts across fashion, travel, food, wellness, and other lifestyle categories.

title: Dark Matter: Eternal’s chatbot will keep user conversations private even from the company — Deepinder Goyal
summary: In a letter to shareholders, Goyal explained the idea behind Dark was to remove the worry that someone, someday, can read what you tell an AI bot. “All of us have a dark side, and it needs an outlet where it doesn’t have to hide,” he wrote.

title: Einride expands Nvidia partnership to deploy AI reasoning model for self-driving trucks

title: Booking.com targeted in EU investigation into phishing scams, fraudulent listings
